name: green-zone-straddle-engulfing
note: TRUTH TABLE ROW — a bar that ENGULFS the whole zone (high=120, low=80) crosses both edges strictly, so both predicates terminate at bar 2 and mitigate. The upper CONTROL row: a straddle implementation that tested only containment, or that required the bar to stop inside the zone, would fail here while the equality rows still passed.
source:
indicator("SB", shorttitle="SB", overlay=true)
spawn = bar_index == 0
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "T", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.touch, mitigated_color=color.gray)
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "S", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, mitigated_color=color.gray)
